Himmat ek-doosre ko lag jaati hai.
Kaanp ke bhi act karna—courage.
Khamoshi ek panah hai.
Sabar kamyabi ki maa hai.
Grit adig hai.
Silence ko emptiness mat samjho.
Apne darr ko jeeto.
Khamoshi samajh ki zubaan hai.
Courage tab shuru hota hai jab hum aate hain aur apne aap ko dikhate hain.
Himmat hai fear ko chhodne ki power.
Khamoshi dil ki hifazat karti.
Alag hone ki himmat karo.
Mahaan dimaag vicharon par, aam dimaag ghatnaon par, aur chhote dimaag logon par baatchaat karte hain.
Shaant logon ke dimaag shor karte hain.
Jo hansne se dar ko jeet le, wahi sahaswala hai.
Safal vyakti aur anya logon ke beech farak takat ki kami nahi, gyaan ki kami nahi, balki ichcha ki kami hai.
Har experience se strength, courage, confidence banta hai—jab tum fear ko face karte ho.
